verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships user-defined Triggers: regex rules on terminal output that automatically highlight text, run commands, respond to prompts, send notifications, set marks or invoke Python scripts. It adds Automatic Profile Switching rules keyed on host, user or directory, and the Python API can create custom triggers. A community user corroborates an event-driven Python script that switches themes with the system appearance. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the Triggers feature specifically.
